component.name: SpotyPop
component.summary: A Spotify mini player for the COSMIC™ desktop panel

description.p: SpotyPop puts Spotify in the panel of the COSMIC™ desktop: the current song with its cover or a live audio scope, and a popup to control playback, search, browse your playlists and podcasts, and manage the queue.
It can also turn this computer into a Spotify Connect device, so music plays without the Spotify app open. Requires Spotify Premium and a free Spotify developer app for its Client ID.

SpotyPop is an adaptation of omarchy-spotify by Ninepoint Labs and Omarchy-Spotify by Kristoffer Haugland, both MIT licensed. It is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Spotify or System76.
